recognize_zh: 血液與骨髓抹片可見大量母細胞，且有兩種大小：小型、染色質較緻密、細胞質極少的淋巴母細胞樣細胞，以及較大、染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質較多的母細胞；骨髓切片為瀰漫母細胞取代。形態上無法確定系別，需靠流式與免疫染色證實 B/T 雙系及 BCR::ABL1。
features: PB: circulating blasts of intermediate to large size with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, alongside a mature neutrophil

BM aspirate: marked increase in blasts with a dimorphic appearance: smaller blasts with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and larger blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Blast nuclei round to irregular or indented; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules evident
BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous blasts with scattered residual erythroid precursors
Occasional maturing granulocytes present, without basophilia or myeloid left-shifted maturation typical of CML in the fields shown
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by blasts that appear heterogeneous in size, including small lymphoblast-like cells with scant cytoplasm and larger blasts with dispersed chromatin, nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. The trephine biopsy is hypercellular with diffuse sheets of blasts and marked reduction of normal hematopoiesis. Lineage cannot be assigned morphologically; flow cytometry and immunohistochemistry demonstrate discrete B-lymphoblastic and T-lymphoblastic populations, and cytogenetics show t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with BCR::ABL1 fusion. Findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/T, with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2); BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, but flow cytometry shows a single B-lineage blast population without a separate cytoplasmic CD3+/CD1a+ T-lymphoblast population.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: History or residual chronic-phase features (basophilia, myeloid left shift, small hypolobated megakaryocytes) favor CML blast phase, which is excluded before diagnosing MPAL.
Shows only a T-lineage blast population and typically lacks t(9;22), whereas here a distinct B-lineage population coexists.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-negative by morphology too, but flow shows CD13/CD33/CD117 with MPO by flow in a subset and no lymphoid lineage-defining markers.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Bone marrow aspirate: dimorphic blast population of small and larger blasts
Bone marrow biopsy: diffuse sheets of blasts replacing the marrow
